description: §8.10 Tier 2 loop hoisting (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"): a loop whose body can write the database between iterations is NOT hoisted (D-BATCH-001 near-miss) — the write is through a called function (one call deep, two calls deep, or the function passed as a value to a built-in method); §8.10.1 condition 4 already keeps a second `?{}` out of the body itself. Each cell equals the same function compiled with `.nobatch()`. Pre-fix (2dd6d35d9, S456): the pre-fetch was taken before iteration 1, so the second iteration read the stale row (viaCall "hello,hello" instead of "hello,hello!"). The hoist decision itself (including the control: a call the compiler proves write-free keeps the loop hoisted) is pinned by compiler/tests/unit/s456-hoist-divergences.test.js.
rationale: §8.10.3: "Per-iteration `Map` lookup preserves loop-iteration order for all body side effects — `lift`, reactive writes (`@x = ...`), nested server calls, `fail`, `break`, early `return`. The rewritten loop is observationally equivalent to the un-rewritten loop on all side-effect orderings." A body that may write between iterations has no equivalent pre-fetch.
